name: Caustic Wounds
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

Area aura centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create an aura of acid that aggravates wounds in the area. All bleed damage in the aura is converted to acid damage and increased by 1d4. Additionally, any creature that takes piercing or slashing damage takes an additional 1d8 acid damage.
